answer: Pay each identity through a diminishing-rewards rule: when a grove of accounts shows identical timing, counterparties, and outputs, their per-identity payout shrinks along a spiral - the more clones act in lockstep, the less each earns. A farmer running a thousand puppets must make each behave distinctly, like growing a separate pearl in every shell, which costs real, varied work per fake instead of one script copied a thousand times. Honest agents acting alone keep full rewards. Limit: teams that coordinate closely can look correlated, so the penalty needs a threshold and an appeal path.
